SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
--LINKMYROWDATA --LINKDETAILLIST(KEEWAYZUP6010X,700,{0},{1},{2},{3},{4}) DECLARE @LAN VARCHAR(30) = '#LOGIN_LAN#'; DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = (SELECT #LC.X3ERP#GETLANX3(@LAN)); DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(10)='{0}'; DECLARE @SOHNUM VARCHAR(30)='%{1}%'; DECLARE @BPC NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{2}%'; DECLARE @ITM NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{3}%';
SELECT TOP 500 SOQ.SOHNUM_0 AS 销售订单号 ,SOQ.SOPLIN_0 AS 销售订单行 ,SOQ.SOQSEQ_0 AS 行序号 ,SOH.CUSORDREF_0 AS 参考号 ,SOH.SALFCY_0 AS 地点 ,SOH.STOFCY_0 AS 装运地点 ,SOH.ORDDAT_0 AS 日期 ,IIF(BPC.BPCSHO_0 = '', BPC.BPCNAM_0, BPC.BPCSHO_0) AS 客户 ,SOQ.ITMREF_0 AS 产品编码 ,ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS 产品描述1 ,ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0) AS 产品描述2 ,SOP.SAU_0 单位 ,CAST(SOQ.QTY_0 AS REAL) 订单数量 ,CAST(ISNULL(XWS.QTYPCU_0, 0) AS REAL) 已备数量 ,CAST(SOQ.ODLQTY_0 + SOQ.DLVQTY_0 AS REAL) 已发数量 ,CAST(SOQ.QTY_0 - ISNULL(XWS.QTYPCU_0, 0) - SOQ.ODLQTY_0 - SOQ.DLVQTY_0 AS REAL) 剩余数量 ,CASE WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 = 3 THEN 'required' ELSE '' END AS REQFLG ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(XWS.QTYPCU_0, 0) > 0 THEN 'E02' WHEN SOQ.QTY_0 > SOQ.ODLQTY_0 + SOQ.DLVQTY_0 AND SOQ.ODLQTY_0 + SOQ.DLVQTY_0 <> 0 THEN 'A02' ELSE 'C01' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR ,SOH.SOHNUM_0 + CAST(SOQ.SOPLIN_0 AS VARCHAR) AS SOURCEPK ,ITF.DEFLOC_2 库位 ,'{4}' 过账日期 ,SOQ.SOHNUM_0 + CAST(SOQ.SOPLIN_0 AS VARCHAR) AS id ,CASE WHEN ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0 > 1 THEN N'lang:{zh:批次号管理,en:Batch Management,de:Chargenverwaltung}' ELSE '' END LOTFLG ,CASE WHEN SERMGTCOD_0 >1 THEN N'lang:{zh:序列号管理,en:Serial Number Management,de:Seriennummernverwaltung}' ELSE '' END SERFLG FROM SORDERQ SOQ LEFT JOIN SORDERP SOP ON SOQ.SOHNUM_0 = SOP.SOHNUM_0 AND SOQ.SOPLIN_0 = SOP.SOPLIN_0 AND SOQ.SOQSEQ_0 = SOP.SOPSEQ_0 LEFT JOIN SORDER SOH ON SOH.SOHNUM_0 = SOQ.SOHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN BPCUSTOMER BPC ON SOH.BPCORD_0 = BPC.BPCNUM_0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT SDH.SOHNUM_0 ,SUM(SDH.QTYPCU_0) QTYPCU_0 ,SOPLIN_0 FROM XWSSDH SDH WHERE SOHNUM_0 LIKE @SOHNUM AND RPFLG_0 <> 3 GROUP BY SDH.SOHNUM_0 ,SDH.SOPLIN_0)XWS ON SOQ.SOHNUM_0 = XWS.SOHNUM_0 AND SOQ.SOPLIN_0 = XWS.SOPLIN_0 LEFT JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = SOQ.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN1 L1 ON L1.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L1.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN2 L2 ON L2.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L2.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON ITF.STOFCY_0 = SOH.STOFCY_0 AND ITF.ITMREF_0 = SOQ.ITMREF_0 WHERE SOQ.SOQSTA_0 <> 3 AND SOQ.QTY_0 - SOQ.DLVQTY_0 - SOQ.ODLQTY_0 > 0 AND SOH.SALFCY_0 = @FCY AND SOH.SOHNUM_0 LIKE UPPER(@SOHNUM) AND BPC.BPCNUM_0 + UPPER(BPC.BPCNAM_0) + UPPER(BPC.BPCSHO_0) LIKE UPPER(@BPC) AND ITM.ITMREF_0 + UPPER(ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0)+ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0) ) LIKE UPPER(@ITM) ORDER BY XWS.QTYPCU_0 DESC
